finalText:
**No-touch spots found, sign-off is conditional.**

Renaming `account_id` → `owner_id` touches 1082 occurrences across 94 files: 5 services (orders, notify, billing, analytics, accounts), shared `lib/`, `vendor/`, `migrations/`, and `docs/openapi.yaml`.

Three places must keep `account_id` no matter what:

| Location | Reason |
|---|---|
| [lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js:8) | right side is the public JSON field, frozen by clients |
| `docs/openapi.yaml` | documents that same public contract |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk/*` | generated, vendored, overwritten by `npm run vendor:refresh` |

Also leave every file under `migrations/` untouched. Each has a comment saying they're applied history and editing breaks the down step. A rename there needs a new migration, not edits to old ones.

That leaves the internal DB column and in-service code as the actual renameable surface, roughly 90 files.

Next: confirm platform team's plan adds a new migration and keeps `serialize.js`'s left side in sync, not the right.
